id: title:jurajmajerik:align code tab styling with the rest of the scene

review.posthog_relevance: Updates the frontend implementation of the Experimentation feature, replacing custom warning and instruction containers with standardized PostHog UI components (`LemonBanner`) and refining the visual hierarchy of implementation steps.
review.reason: The observed changes replace custom, potentially deprecated or inconsistent UI markup with standardized PostHog components (`LemonBanner`) and reorganize the presentation of implementation instructions. This represents a substantive, bounded improvement in the reliability and consistency of the user interface for the Experimentation feature, rather than a narrow documentation-only,
review.uncertainty: While the replacement of custom divs with a dedicated component and the addition of headers are substantive, the complete absence of tests, migration checks, or backend compatibility assertions in this chunk prevents assigning a Tier 3 score. The benefit is demonstrated, but not fully validated.

observations.limitations: All supplied hunks are from a single chunk. No indication of unrelated PRs. No score assigned.
